hook.name: AlgebraIntegralAggregator
hook.description: Aggregator hook that routes Uniswap v4 swaps to external Algebra Integral DEX pools registered by the owner. The v4 pool holds no liquidity; `beforeSwap` executes the trade on the bound Algebra pool and returns a full delta, consuming the entire swap. Supports Uniswap v4 protocol fees; the owner can register additional Algebra sources (factory + deployer pairs) and pools.
